cut: RFH global, VIRAL CUT v1 (24 Oct): towns sign secrecy deals (NDAs) about data centres in their own town. Hook first (the sealed NDA envelope on the town hall steps); the blank data centre rises behind the houses; Virginia, 25 of 31 places checked; the developers' stated reason, insider trading rules; Delaware banned them in August, the envelope tears: loop.
argument: Towns sign secrecy deals with data-centre developers about buildings in their own town; Virginia records requests found them in 25 of 31 places, developers cite insider trading rules, and Delaware banned them in August 2026.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

captions.source: Framing of the record below: local governments in several US states have signed NDAs with data-centre developers (Virginia Mercury 25 Oct 2024; Bloomberg Government 2026; Wisconsin Watch Jan 2026; Spotlight PA Aug 2026; NPR 26 Aug 2026). 'Your town' is the address to the viewer, not a claim about any one town.

captions.source: The NDAs cover proposed or existing data-centre projects in the signing locality (Virginia Mercury 25 Oct 2024: NDAs signed by Fredericksburg, Stafford, Caroline, Louisa, Orange and Culpeper with data-centre developers; Bloomberg Government).

text.en: Virginia: secrecy / deals in [25 of 31] / places checked.
text.ja: バージニア州： 調べた / 31か所中 [25か所] で / 秘密保持契約。

captions.source: Eric Bonds (University of Mary Washington) and students sent public records requests in 2025 to every Virginia locality with a proposed or existing data-centre project; reported results: 25 of 31 had NDAs. Outlets word the unit as localities (Yahoo/Newsweek) or as proposed projects (Bloomberg Government), hence 'places checked'. Search summaries only; the study itself not opened.

text.ja: 開発業者の 理由： / [インサイダー取引] 規制。

captions.source: Tom's Hardware: a developer argues the NDAs are important to avoid running afoul of insider-trading rules ('Many talks between data center developers and local governments are under NDA…'). Attributed as the developers' stated reason, as reported; a tag says AS REPORTED. Search summary only.

text.ja: デラウェア州は 8月に / [禁止]。

captions.source: Delaware SB 312 (2026), signed 26 Aug 2026 (legis.delaware.gov bill page): prohibits state agencies, counties and municipalities from entering NDAs that restrict public access to information about potential or actual large-scale data-centre development (100 MW or more); such NDAs void and unenforceable. Search summaries of the bill page, WHYY, DelCOG; the enacted text not opened.

post.en: Towns sign secrecy deals about data centres in their own town. In Virginia, records requests found them in 25 of 31 places checked. The developers' reason, as reported: insider trading rules. Delaware banned them in August, for data centres of 100 MW+. Did your town sign one?
post.fi: Kunnat allekirjoittavat salassapitosopimuksia datakeskusrakennuttajien kanssa omista hankkeistaan. Virginiassa sopimus löytyi 25 paikasta 31:stä. Rakennuttajien perustelu uutisten mukaan: sisäpiirisäännöt. Delaware kielsi ne elokuussa. Allekirjoittiko sinun kuntasi?
post.ja: データセンター開発業者と、地元の建物について秘密保持契約を結ぶ町がある。バージニア州では調べた31か所中25か所で見つかった。報道によれば開発業者の理由はインサイダー取引規制。デラウェア州は8月に禁止した。あなたの町は？
